# Personal AI Philosophies {#sec-ai-philosophies}

::: {.callout-note icon="false" title="This content was identified, synthesized, and written by humans."}
📜 Nonetheless, you may enjoy reading about Claude's constitution[@anthropic2026constitution], partly written by Claude.
:::

AI has thus far evolved quicker than scientific policies and norms, making it more important than ever to reflect upon values, principles, and personal goals. We thus have begun imagining a future wherein researchers are explicitly asked to articulate their philosophy on AI (e.g., in a document that accompanies research and teaching statements in job applications). Academics are bound to develop different philosophies around AI[@fehr2026objectors], and our seminar was no different. Fortunately, 8 seminar participants agreed to share drafts of their own AI philosophy statements — all in hopes that future generations of academics will continue the reflection (@tbl-ai-philosophies).
